authority: Validates independently authenticated human submissions, exact frozen assessment references, signed collection closure and descriptive reporting. It does not act as a judge, qualify learned judgment, create ratings, choose acceptance criteria or declare an advantage.
failure_or_lesson: Independently randomized single-phase pairs cannot establish appropriate change or unrelated stability. A self-declared sealed flag also cannot authorize trustworthy unblinding. Require an authorized longitudinal view with constant anonymous arm identity and a separately signed complete collection; leave unsupported dimensions unassessed.
goal: Prepare the independent held-out human scoring seam without inventing a model, judge, rating, numerical threshold or behavioral result.
notes: Procedure seed only. Selected encrypted rating/spec/seal persistence and seal-enforced identity-key export remain integration work. Final cohort, actual rubrics, thresholds, reviewer recruitment, model inference, uncertainty method and acceptance analysis remain unclaimed.
procedure: Verify actual frozen rubric, threshold and case bytes; bind approved reviewer credentials and all pair assignments; authenticate exact human labels, notes and output bindings; store canonical copies without an edit path; reject unsupported longitudinal labels; require independent authorization and actual before/after output views for change or stability; obtain a separate coordinator signature only after complete collection; reverify all signatures and actual private run mapping before descriptive reporting; retain failures and unknown assessments without inventing an acceptance result.
validation: Thirteen local contract regressions passed with fictional run receipts, rubric bytes, human labels, independently configured signing keys and explicit view-permission fixtures. Checks include concurrent duplicate intake, independent seal credentials and fully failed comparison-stratum denominators. No actual human study, learned model, selected-store rating persistence or behavioral advantage was exercised; combined CI pending.
